column1: # regex acceptance vectors, from ECMA-262 22.2.
# The validator is a structural check (balanced parens, terminated classes,
# defined escapes), so it accepts ECMA-262 patterns RE2 rejects and rejects only
# structurally malformed patterns. The official suite holds three string cases
# against this format: a valid pattern and an unbalanced parenthesis in
# optional/format/regex.json, and "\a" in optional/format/ecmascript-regex.json,
# which suite_test.go skips under reasonAnnexBIdentity as a documented
# divergence. These rows write down the class boundary all three leave open.
# Row format: see loadVectorFile in vectors_test.go.

column1: # ECMA-262 22.2.1 defines CharacterClass as '[' [lookahead != ^] ClassContents

# read the POSIX bracket expression instead and rejected the empty class;
# fdbad66 restored it. These rows are why the question does not reopen.
